data_governance.unseen_data_requirement: Must be evaluated exclusively on an unconsumed historical dataset (e.g. external broker feed or future forward window strictly disjoint from all consumed data)

pre_registered_hypotheses.statement: Enforcing ADX(14) > 22.0 eliminates negative-expectancy trades during low-volatility ranging regimes, raising out-of-sample win rate above 42%.
Restricting execution to London and NY overlap (07:00-17:00 UTC) eliminates Asian session drag (-$429.16), improving overall profit factor by >= 0.35.
Buffering stops by 1.5x ATR reduces premature stop-outs during institutional liquidity sweeps without degrading risk-reward expectancy.
